_note: SAMPLE fault types for the demo. To use FixMyKasi's real 34 types, replace this list (same fields). 'autoUrgent' marks types that are always urgent. 'keywords' are words a resident might use; a match adds a small score bonus.

faultTypes.name: Faulty streetlight
faultTypes.description: Street light is flickering, dark, not working or stays on during the day.

faultTypes.name: Exposed live wire
faultTypes.description: Exposed electrical wire or cable hanging low, sparking or dangerous to touch.

faultTypes.name: Power outage
faultTypes.description: No electricity in the street or area, transformer or substation is down.

faultTypes.name: Damaged electricity box
faultTypes.description: Electricity meter box or pole is damaged, open or leaning.

faultTypes.name: Burst water main
faultTypes.description: A big water pipe has burst and water is flooding the street.

faultTypes.name: Water leak
faultTypes.description: Small water leak from a pipe, tap or meter, water running onto the road.

faultTypes.name: No water supply
faultTypes.description: No running water at home or in the area for a long time.

faultTypes.name: Low water pressure
faultTypes.description: Water comes out very slowly or only a trickle.

faultTypes.name: Sewage overflow
faultTypes.description: Sewage is overflowing from a manhole or drain, bad smell, dirty water in the street.

faultTypes.name: Blocked drain
faultTypes.description: Drain or storm water channel is blocked with rubbish or sand.

faultTypes.name: Broken communal toilet
faultTypes.description: Public or communal toilet is broken, locked or dirty.

faultTypes.name: Pothole
faultTypes.description: A hole in the road surface that can damage cars or hurt people.

faultTypes.name: Sinkhole or collapsed road
faultTypes.description: The road has collapsed or a large hole opened up, dangerous for cars and children.

faultTypes.name: Damaged sidewalk
faultTypes.description: Broken or uneven pavement or walkway.

faultTypes.name: Missing road sign
faultTypes.description: Traffic sign, stop sign or street name sign is missing or knocked over.

faultTypes.name: Broken traffic light
faultTypes.description: Traffic light or robot is out, stuck or showing the wrong colour at a busy intersection.

faultTypes.name: Uncollected rubbish
faultTypes.description: Rubbish bins were not collected, bags piling up on the street.

faultTypes.name: Illegal dumping
faultTypes.description: People dumped rubble, tyres or household waste on an open piece of land.

faultTypes.name: Overflowing public bin
faultTypes.description: Public bin or skip is full and rubbish is spilling onto the ground.

faultTypes.name: Fallen tree or branch
faultTypes.description: A tree or large branch has fallen and blocks the road or a house.

faultTypes.name: Broken playground equipment
faultTypes.description: Swings, slides or jungle gym in the park are broken or unsafe for children.

faultTypes.name: Open manhole
faultTypes.description: Manhole cover is missing or open, a person or car could fall in.

faultTypes.name: Dangerous stray animals
faultTypes.description: Aggressive stray dogs or loose animals in the area.
